g.text: Chamber contribution to AF-associated NCP family rewiring

text.style: font-size: 5.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Each point is one family in one cohort. x = ΔaCAIrel_LA, y = ΔaCAIrel_RA (AF - SR). Point colour denotes the dominant chamber contribution (|LA| ≥ 1.25|RA|: LA-dominant; |RA| ≥ 1.25|LA|: RA-dominant; else bilateral). Dashed diagonals are y = x (co-shift) and y = -x (antagonistic shift).
